bluejetty:00062809:ios.description:
Discover the world of knowledge with Ultimate Facts. Our app is the ultimate source for fascinating and informative facts. Our team of experts has carefully selected thousands of facts from hundreds of different subjects, all verified for accuracy. 
**** Daily exciting and Random Facts! **** 
We make learning fun with Ultimate Facts. Ultimate Facts helps you learn something new and exciting daily by showing you random facts when you unlock your phone. Just set your preferences, like when and how many facts you want to know, and let Ultimate Facts do the rest. 
There are many features in Ultimate Facts that no fact app has. For example, It has an "Article" page with a detailed explanation of each point and a resource link to gain insight and learn more. 
**** Discover Fun Facts Now! **** 
Our editors meticulously check all the facts in Ultimate Fact from the most reliable sources such as academic papers, Wikipedia, History, National Geographic, Guinness World Records, and many more. 
All facts have audio recordings. This way, you can listen to the facts whenever you want while walking, running, or doing sports.

bluejetty:00068113:ios.description:
Rainbow by Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise is a secure and relationship-building engine that facilitates quick, seamless collaboration between its users. 
It allows users to swiftly interact with each other through chat, voice or video and to share screens and files with astonishing ease.
But Rainbow goes beyond simple messaging and sharing. Rainbow leverages the latest technologies to securely integrate into your organization’s existing business processes, applications, and workflows, while streamlining user adoption, minimizing user disruption, and solving customer challenges. 
Rainbow helps you connect to the future through optimized time-management, secure platform access, and strict data integrity.
COMMUNICATE AND COLLABORATE
- Initiate high-definition audio and video calls.
- Start group chats (bubbles) to communicate with your teams and business contacts.
- Add people from outside your organization (Guests) in your conversations.
- Create or join audio and video meetings with up to 120 participants.
- Use channels to broadcast information inside or outside your organization.
- Always stay connected so you never miss messages, calls, meetings or any other event.
- Manage your phone calls (via the cellular network or using Voice over IP) through your enterprise telephony system, access your voicemail and much more.
ORGANIZE AND SHARE
- Share contents you want in your conversations (pictures, files, videos, animated GIFs, voice memos, locations).
- Search for people, bubbles, channels, files or text messages.
- Manage your contact network, see presence of your colleagues or people outside your company.
- Share you calendar information (free, busy, out of office) to let others know if you are available.
DATA INTEGRITY AND PRIVACY
We respect privacy. We don’t use data to monetize additional services and we respect international privacy laws and data privacy. 
Data of our partners and customers is private, safe and secure. Only our partners and customers process their own data. 
Transparency and traceability are critical elements of Rainbow and all regulatory requirements are respected.

bluejetty:00060757:ios.name: SyroMalabar Praarthanakal
bluejetty:00060757:ios.summary: A collection of Malayalam Liturgy of the Hours ( Yaama Praarthanakal) and Sacramentals used in the Syro-Malabar Catholic Church. For your convenience, the app employs algorithms to determine the prayer combinations to be used for each day
bluejetty:00060757:ios.description:
A collection of Malayalam Liturgy of the Hours ( Yaama Praarthanakal) and Sacramentals used in the Syro-Malabar Catholic Church. For your convenience, the app employs algorithms to determine the prayer combinations to be used for each day (based on the nine Liturgical seasons, position of weeks, and day of the week) and presents you with a ready-to-read fully-composed text off the screen.
A mobile ministry of http://praarthana.org, this app has all the seven prayers: Ramsha, Leliya, Sapra, Qala d-Shahra, Qutta aa, Endana and d-Bassa Sayin, as well as al major Sacramentals such as blessings, Oppees etc.
The app also includes a convenient night reading mode to help read comfortably in the dark, like when reciting the late night or early morning prayers in solitude. The text size can also be increased or decreased per your convenience, and both these can be accessed via the Floating Action Button at bottom right corner of the application.
The prayer text also includes a play button, which turns your device into a teleprompter, enabling you to pray without the constant scrolling gestures on the phone. The feature can be used in conjunction with a big screen television or a projector for an entire gathering to comfortably say the prayers.

For more info or to create a new Prosper investor account, please visit http://prosper.com/invest .

Container docklands and skidpad training maps

Smooth and responsive controls
Vehicle customization: suspension, wheels, and paint
Skill-based gameplay focused on precision
Optimized performance for iOS devices

Build your car.
Train your control.
Just Drift.
IGRS Rating: 3+

bluejetty:00014887:ios.name: WooCommerce: Store & POS
bluejetty:00014887:ios.summary:
Manage your business on the go with the WooCommerce Mobile App. Add products, create orders, take quick payments, and keep an eye on new sales and key stats in real time.
Add and edit products with a touch
Get started in seconds! Create, g
bluejetty:00014887:ios.description:
Manage your business on the go with the WooCommerce Mobile App. Add products, create orders, take quick payments, and keep an eye on new sales and key stats in real time.
Add and edit products with a touch
Get started in seconds! Create, group, and publish products directly from your iPhone or iPad. Capture your creativity the moment it strikes – turn your ideas into products immediately, or save them as drafts for later.
Create orders on the fly
Once you have some products created, it’s simple. Choose items from your catalog, add shipping, and then fill in customer details to quickly create an order that syncs with your inventory.
Take payments in person
Collect physical payments using WooCommerce In-Person Payments and a card reader in Australia, Canada, Finland, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the US. Tap to Pay on iPhone is available in the UK and US. Start a new order – or find an existing one that’s pending payment – then seamlessly accept payment.
Go from clicks to bricks
Turn any tablet into a powerful point of sale with WooCommerce POS. Search products, scan barcodes, apply coupons, and send email receipts, with all of your online and physical sales synced in real time. Available in Australia, Canada, Finland, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Singapore, the UK, and the US.
Get notified of every sale
Now that you’re actively selling, never miss an order or a review. Keep yourself in the loop by enabling real-time alerts – and listen for that addictive “cha-ching” sound that comes with each new sale!
Track sales and bestselling products
See which products are winning at a glance. Keep tabs on your overall revenue, order count, and visitor data by week, month, and year. Knowledge = power.
WooCommerce is the world’s most customizable open-source eCommerce platform. Whether you’re launching a business, taking brick-and-mortar retail online, or developing sites for clients, use WooCommerce for a store that powerfully blends content and commerce.
Requirements: WooCommerce v3.5+.
View the Terms of Service at https://wordpress.com/tos/
View the Privacy Policy at https://automattic.com/privacy/
View the Privacy Notice for California users at https://automattic.com/privacy/#california-consumer-privacy-act-ccpa.

bluejetty:00073914:ios.name: Hondata Complete
bluejetty:00073914:ios.summary:
NOTICE: Before you purchase Hondata Complete, download the "Hondata package" bundle advertised above instead. It includes Autolog, our new app at a discount.
Track performance of your car in real time by gauges and graphs. Troubleshoot mal
bluejetty:00073914:ios.description:
NOTICE: Before you purchase Hondata Complete, download the "Hondata package" bundle advertised above instead. It includes Autolog, our new app at a discount.
Track performance of your car in real time by gauges and graphs. Troubleshoot malfunctions by accessing the on board ECU. Know what is wrong with your car before taking it to the mechanic.Track fuel economy and save money on gas. These are just some of the features the Hondata app has to offer. Hondata app transforms your phone/tablet into an all in one performance tracking and troubleshooting tool for your car. 
The complete edition includes all the addons at a discounted price.
Fautures:
• Customizable gauges can track up to 80 sensors in real time including fuel economy, G-force and battery voltage.
• Read and Clear trouble codes and reset MIL (service engine light).
• Read from more than 40 diagnostics parameters including engine knock count, VTEC pressure and more.
• Metric and Imperial measures.
• Real-time user-defined sensor plotting. Graph up to 4 sensors at the same time on interactive graph that can be scrolled, paused and polled.
• Gauge list feature can track every sensor at the same time.
• CarPlay allows you to display sensor data in real time on car dash screen.
• Instant horsepower, mpg/kml fuel economy, boost pressure and G force tracking.
• Speed limit warning: Get notified when driving over speed limit.
• High coolant temperature warning gives you instant notification when your car is running too hot.
• HUD mode for dashboard view : Heads up display for driving at night.
• Two themes to choose from.
• landscape mode for all views.
• Fuel Economy:
 - Live and average fuel economy tracking for 0-5 min, 0-30 min and 0-2 hr intervals and a detailed summary.
 - Long term tracking with six different intervals. (1 week, 2 weeks, 4 weeks, 13 weeks, 26 and 52 weeks).
 - 4 different units of measure: MPG,KPL (Km/L), L/100 Km, Miles per imperial gallon.
 - Interactive graph of long term data that can be cropped and scrolled through.
 - Export fuel history to CSV file (spreadsheets).
 - Other statistics: Distance travelled, average speed, money spent, CO2 produced and fuel consumed.
 - 4 methods of calculation available. For non MAF equipped vehicles.
• Race track package: 
 - Real time lap data, gap delay time and position in race track using high frequency GPS tracking.
 - Comprehensive summary of race with lap times, speed fluctuations on track and more.
 - Get drag racing times (0-60 mph, 0-100 mph, 1/4 mile 1/8 mile etc.) 
 - Load and save unlimited number of tracks onto device.
 - Crucial racing data including real time horsepower, g-force and a detailed driving summary. Share your results with friends.
 - Transmission gear information and optional shifting assistant (for manual transmission vehicles) which notifies optimal moment for shifting.
 - Customizable view that toggles between speed/rpm gauge, real time track positioning and G-sensor feedback.
 - Record your race in HD with gauge and track overlays. (dash cam add-on required)
• Dashcam: 
Record smooth HD video with overlaying gauges (speed,rpm, etc), time, location (GPS coordinates) and G-force sensor in four different resolutions. Record from 80 sensors and up to 5 gauges.
• Sensor logger: 
 - Record as many sensors as possible.
 - Save graph sensor data to CSV file and export it for further analysis. 
 - Send real time data to a TCP socket (IP Address) over the network.
*Your vehicle must be equipped with MAF sensor for instant horsepower and torque readout*
*Your vehicle must be equipped with MAP sensor for boost pressure readout*
Visit www.hondata.com for more info.
For help: mobile@hondata.com

bluejetty:00033476:ios.description:
In the ancient era full of chaos, the world was not yet clear and everything was shrouded in fog. When the original fire ignited, the world began to awaken. Heat and cold, life and death, light and darkness, these opposite and unified elements, began to shape the world. The original fire brought not only life and civilization, but also the desire for power and the ambition for domination.
Under the influence of desire and ambition, the ancient war between good and evil broke out.
[Exquisite Picture]
Unique and beautiful picture quality as same as that of PC game, gorgeous light effect rendering, advanced 3D art, and magnificent buildings coming into view, allowing players to immerse themselves in this Xianxia world.
[Sky fighting]
Fly with a dragon and fight with enemies in the sky to experience the ultimate excitement and freedom, and become a legendary fighter in the sky!
[Massive Battle]

bluejetty:00026290:ios.description:
Learn German with Dialogues - Your Ultimate German Learning Companion
Welcome to our free application designed to help you master the German language through engaging dialogues. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, you will find a wide range of dialogues, each crafted to match your skill level. Written and narrated dialogues are accompanied by a series of questions to test your comprehension and reinforce your learning.
New and Improved Features:
- Interactive AI Conversations: Practice every dialogue live with our AI! Speak freely, get instant corrections on pronunciation and grammar, and have real back-and-forth conversations tailored to your level.
- Translation Options: Now, each dialogue includes translations in English and Spanish, making it even more accessible and useful for non-German speakers.
- Offline Access: All dialogues are downloaded at the start, allowing you to use the app offline whenever and wherever you want.
- PDF Export and Print: Convert dialogues into PDF format for easy printing and sharing.
- Enhanced Quizzes: Each dialogue now includes 5 questions to provide a more comprehensive understanding check.
- Adjustable Audio Speed: Customize the playback speed of the audio to suit your learning pace.
- Night Mode: Reduce eye strain and study comfortably with the app's night mode.
Why Choose Our App?
- Real Conversations with AI: Stop just listening – start speaking! The AI acts as your personal German conversation partner and corrects you in real time.
- Regular Updates: New dialogues are published weekly, ensuring that you have fresh and relevant content to continue improving your German skills.
- User-Friendly Design: The app is designed with simplicity and usability in mind, making it easy for anyone to navigate and use.
- 100% Free: Enjoy all these features at no cost.
How to Use:
- Read the Dialogues: Carefully go through each dialogue.
- Listen to the Audio: Ensure you listen to the narrated versions to perfect your pronunciation.
- Answer the Questions: Test your comprehension with the quizzes provided.
- Utilize the Translations: Refer to the translations in English and Spanish to aid your understanding.
- Download and Print: Take advantage of the PDF export options to study on the go.
With our new AI feature, you’re not just listening to dialogues anymore — you’re having real conversations and becoming fluent faster than ever!
Feedback and Support:
We are dedicated to improving your learning experience. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please contact us at info@zgdevelopment.ch. Your input is invaluable to us.
If you enjoy using the app, please rate us on the App Store and share it with others who might benefit from it.
Download the app now and embark on your journey to mastering German with engaging dialogues!
--- Legal Information ---
The app offers auto-renewing subscriptions. By subscribing, you agree to the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA) which apply to all in-app purchases: 
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00064944:ios.description:
Hi, I’m George!
I’ll help you with all things money. 
I’m clear and intuitive
With just a few taps, I’ll help you open an account, get a card, set up savings, investments, insurance or a loan. Forgot your card PIN, need to block your card or change your limits? I’ll sort it out in no time.
Everything in one place
No switching between apps. Everything you need is right here in one place: your current account, investments, savings and loans.
Payments at rocket speed
I’ll transfer money from one account to another without unnecessary waiting. Need to settle up with your colleagues? Create a Payme link, scan an IBAN or QR code.
I’ll give you money back on your purchases
Activate Moneyback and get some of your money back from your purchases. Save on travel, fashion, electronics and much more.
I also have a version for kids
I’ll teach the little ones how to save and manage money in a fun way, while parents can keep track of how their child spends money directly in their app.
I’ll get your finances into shape
In the FIT zone, we’ll take a closer look at your financial health and I’ll give you tips on how you can save money.
Put your spare change aside
Save while you spend. I’ll round up every card payment and transfer the difference to your savings account.
I’ve also got a currency calculator
Business trip to the Czech Republic or holiday in Türkiye ? Press and hold the app icon and convert prices using the current exchange rate.
Withdraw cash using your phone
I’ll show you the nearest ATM and you can withdraw cash easily using your phone. 
I’ll arrange a meeting with our experts
An in-person meeting, phone call or video call ? It’s up to you. Just tap the " Contacts" section.

bluejetty:00027059:ios.summary:
Get the most out of your closet - for less than the price of a latte, you could change your relationship with clothes and find your unique personal style!
Stylebook® is the longest-running closet organization app for a reason - with over 9
bluejetty:00027059:ios.description:
Get the most out of your closet - for less than the price of a latte, you could change your relationship with clothes and find your unique personal style!
Stylebook® is the longest-running closet organization app for a reason - with over 90 features to help you curate your closet! This time-tested app is an expert wardrobe management and closet organization tool, and has been loved by customers for 15+ years.
Import your actual clothes in seconds with a variety of import tools, including AI image generation. Use your real clothes to collage magazine-style outfits so you can wear an outfit you love every day. If you’re out of ideas, the app can even make outfits for you. Plus, plan what to wear on the outfit calendar, create packing lists that automatically tell you which clothes to pack, and learn more about your wardrobe with stats like cost per wear - all in this customizable app!
Stylebook is the ultimate tool to mix and match your wardrobe and get more wears out of your clothes without feeling bored. If you want to break out of the micro-trend cycle and gain true personal style - it’s for you.
OUR STORY:
Stylebook’s features were inspired by the co-founder's real-life experience organizing clothes in the Vogue fashion closet and her journey to find her personal style while working with a nonexistent budget. As the app evolved over the years, it's become a way for anyone to fall in love with their wardrobe, helping them to save time and money, get more wears out of their clothes, and make their wardrobes more sustainable. We’re a small family-owned and operated business. 
REVIEWS:
FEATURED BY: Vogue, WSJ, Harper's Bazaar UK, New York Magazine, Articles of Interest, Confidently Insecure, Sustainable Fashion for Dummies, the Conscious Style Podcast, & more!
"Easily see what is working and what isn’t" - Vogue.com
"Closet-organization apps allow you to catalog your wardrobe and play stylist...I find Stylebook to be the most intuitive." - NYTimes
"Our new wardrobe secret weapon is the @StylebookApp" - The Outnet
10 Must-Have iPhone Apps for Fashion Week - Vogue Paris
"The Clueless virtual closet exists in real life, OMG" - Cosmopolitan UK
Condé Nast Traveler's "Best Travel Apps for Packing"
FEATURES:
• CLOSET INVENTORY: quickly add images of your clothes with no need to take photos unless you choose to
• FAST IMPORT: generate clothing images from text with AI*, drag & drop photos, multiple import, & clip from your favorite store websites
• AI BACKGROUND REMOVAL: automatically cut out your clothes, virtually instantly
• LAY OUT OUTFITS: layer & resize clothing on a free-form canvas 
• OUTFIT GENERATOR: shuffle your closet like a deck of cards to reveal new outfit ideas hiding in your closet! 
• CALENDAR: plan what to wear in advance
• PACKING LISTS: add whole outfits, plan how you'll pack ahead of time, generate checklists & infographics
• STYLE STATS: insights into your wardrobe, including what you wear the most & least and which items have the best value
• COST PER WEAR: automatically track CPW for your entire wardrobe
• BROWSE YOUR CLOSET: see everything you own in one place, organized by brand, fabric, color, size, etc.
• INSPIRATION LIBRARY: save all your style inspirations outside the influence of algorithms
• CUSTOM CATEGORIES: add, edit, or delete any category in your closet, looks & inspiration library
• SYNC: automatic sync shows the same data on both your iPhone & iPad
• SHARE: share outfits & clothes via e-mail & social media
• NO LIMITS: add unlimited clothing, accessories, & inspirations
• ICLOUD BACKUP: protect your data with iCloud
• SEARCH: search your closet for keywords or properties like fabric, season, color, etc.
• SHOP: try items with your clothes before buying & bookmark your fave stores!
• E-MAIL SUPPORT: contact support and a real person will help you
Visit stylebookapp.com for the full feature list - plus demo videos of the app!
(*) AI image generation requires Apple Intelligence

bluejetty:00023513:ios.summary: After surviving a plane crash, you must collect resources to craft weapons and tools, build facilities and houses to withstand the elements of this strange island. Battle through various natural environments like fiery volcanoes, freezing g
bluejetty:00023513:ios.description:
After surviving a plane crash, you must collect resources to craft weapons and tools, build facilities and houses to withstand the elements of this strange island. Battle through various natural environments like fiery volcanoes, freezing glaciers, etc. and difficult obstacles such as mutant zombies, militias, wild creatures, etc. Do everything you can to get yourself home.
Game Features:
-MULTIPLAYER
To Survive on this mysterious deserted island, you must form friendships with players from around the world and gather the limited resources.
-CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT
Upgrade your character to stay alive and experience the excitement of what mother nature has to offer to its fullest.
-A UNIQUE ISLAND
The PVE part of this game is unlike any others. Survive and explore natural sceneries like beaches, tropical rainforests, swamps, and volcanoes. At the same time, you are battling your way through man-made obstacles, such as an expedition ship from the 1980s, many secret research labs, ancient underground ruins, and deadly abandoned temples.
-LEARN TO CRAFT AND BUILD
Collect materials and use them to build your own camp! Learn to craft various types of tools and weapons. You will need them to survive! Build your own unique camp with defensive facilities such as sensory tower, arrow tower, etc. and survival facilities like vegetable patches, where you plant seeds and grow food, or workbenches, where you make tools for hunting or gathering!
-PVP OR PVE
It's your choice! Whether to fight or work with other players!
-GO ON EXCITING ADVENTURES
This game was developed to provide players with the Ultimate experience of surviving on a deserted island. The PVE and PVP elements are something you can never find in any other game!
Can you survive this island and get yourself home?
--------------------

2. After activating VIP you will receive the privilege of Craft Anywhere, Backpack Expansion, Quick Search, Building Queue Expansion, Easy Collect, and Easy Sort. 
3. You will be able to claim 50 Crystals every day during the Subscription Period. 
Subscription Instruction:
1. Once the purchase is completed, you will be charged on your Apple Store Account. 
2. Subscription will be automatically renewed.You can turn off the Automatic Renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
3. Your account will be charged automatically within 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. You can manage your Subscription and turn off the Automatic Renewal in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00070816:ios.name: Sensors Toolbox
bluejetty:00070816:ios.summary: Sensors toolbox is the absolute all-in-one diagnostic tool that lets you know virtually everything about your mobile device status. Get full information about all sensors supported by your tablet, smartphone or wearable device. View in comf
bluejetty:00070816:ios.description:
Sensors toolbox is the absolute all-in-one diagnostic tool that lets you know virtually everything about your mobile device status. Get full information about all sensors supported by your tablet, smartphone or wearable device. View in comfortable layout all data from your mobile device sensors in real time, make a sensors tests. Check data on chart (graphic view) and text output available for each sensor and check a detailed description of each detectors and parameters.
All multi tools and sensors device you need in one app: altimeter, metal detector, compass, sport tracker and much more.
This sensors tool box app gives you access to data from:
- accelerometer readings (linear acceleration and gravity sensors)
- gyroscope (calibrated and uncalibrated)
- device 3D orientation
- kinetics sensors
- rotation vector sensors
- other motion and position sensors
- magnetometer, ambient magnetic field values strength (micro Tesla, µT) 
- barometer, pressure sensor
- location, accuracy, altitude
- battery status
- sound level meter and microphone meter (decibel)
- device front and back camera resolution
- smartphone display size, resolution
- device, phone memory, RAM and CPU parameters
and others sensors available in your mobile device. 
With this sensors multitool app you can check what kind of sensors contain your device and test all of this. It supports all the sensors on device and it will tell you which of them are not supported by your hardware.
If you have any problems with this app or ideas to develop, please send us message to apps@examobile.com
Have a fun at work with this ultimate tool!

bluejetty:00045378:ios.description:
Pause, reset, and redirect your mind with guided meditation, mindfulness, self-hypnosis, and daily motivation designed to inspire calm, clarity, confidence, and a growth mindset.
Mindset expert, author, speaker, and celebrity hypnotist Ricky Kalmon shares powerful techniques for personal and professional growth through guided audio experiences that help reduce stress, improve focus, strengthen self-belief, and unlock greater potential. Whether your goal is relaxation, better sleep, improved performance, or a daily mindset reset, you'll discover practical tools to help you create lasting positive change.
The app also features guided meditations, self-hypnosis sessions, mindfulness exercises, breathing techniques, relaxing music, calming sounds, and daily motivation to support your journey toward a more focused, balanced, and empowered life.
PROGRESS TRACKING
Meet your daily streak. Every day you show up, your flame grows: red, then gold, then blue. See how many days in a row you've kept it lit, and how many days you've shown up over the past year.
AI RICKY 
AI RICKY is your on-demand AI mindset coach, delivering personalized guidance on mindset, business, personal growth, golf, and sports performance. Develop a growth mindset, build confidence, navigate challenges, and achieve greater success in professional and personal growth. 
DAILY MOTIVATION
Daily Motivation provides fresh inspiration and practical mindset insights every day to help you stay focused on your goals and potential. Receive daily encouragement, growth mindset reminders, and actionable ideas that empower you to think bigger, overcome challenges, and create lasting success.
MEDITATION
Meditation programs designed to help you quiet the noise, reduce stress, and create greater focus in your daily life. Through guided sessions, you'll learn to reset your mindset, improve mental clarity, and develop a stronger sense of calm, confidence, and presence.
RELAXATION & STRESS RELIEF
Stress can affect your focus, energy, decision-making, and overall well-being. These guided programs help you recognize stress triggers, shift your perspective, and respond more effectively so you can stay calm, focused, and in control. 
SLEEP
These guided sleep sessions help you disconnect from the day, quiet mental chatter, and drift naturally into deep, restorative sleep so you can wake up renewed and ready for tomorrow.
SELF-HYPNOSIS

bluejetty:00042965:ios.summary:
IslamOne brings the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and supplications together in one app — fully readable in English or Urdu, completely free, with no ads and no subscription.
Choose English or Urdu as your reading language and the whole app
bluejetty:00042965:ios.description:
IslamOne brings the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and supplications together in one app — fully readable in English or Urdu, completely free, with no ads and no subscription.
Choose English or Urdu as your reading language and the whole app follows.
QURAN
• Four ways to read: Translation, Tafseer, Surah Mushaf and Parah Mushaf, one tap apart
• 22 translations — 9 English (Saheeh International, Pickthall, Yusuf Ali, Taqi Usmani, Maududi and more) and 13 Urdu
• Tafheem ul Quran and Maarif ul Quran in full English translation — rarely available free
• Word-by-word translation in English and Urdu
• Transliteration throughout for non-Arabic readers
• Translation Only mode: read the meaning ruku by ruku, without the Arabic
• Search in Arabic with or without harakat, in English or in Urdu
• Pin your favourite surahs to the top, bookmark verses with notes, and pick up where you left off
• The dua for completing the Quran at the end of the last parah
AUDIO RECITATION
• Listen to any surah with your choice of reciter
• The Mushaf follows the recitation, highlighting each ayah as it is recited
• Download surahs for offline listening — no internet needed
• Playback speed, surah skip and a floating player you can keep open while you read
• Play from any Ruku in the Mushaf
• Optional Urdu translation audio
HADITH
Eight books in full English translation, including all six major collections — Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abu Dawood, Sunan Nasai, Jame' Tirmidhi and Sunan Ibn Majah, plus Muwatta Imam Malik and Shamail Tirmidhi. Three further books (Mishkaat, Musnad Ahmad, Maarif ul Hadith) are available in Urdu. Narrators, text and takhreej are shown in colour for easier reading.
PRAYER TIMES & QIBLA
• Accurate timings for your location, with every major calculation method and custom adjustments
• Adhan notifications, including the full Adhan
• Qibla compass
• Hijri calendar with manual adjustment for local moon sighting
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for the daily verse, prayer times, fasting and duas
SUPPLICATIONS
Authentic duas organised by occasion, with English translation and transliteration, repeat counters, bookmarks and search. Pin the categories you use most. Dua of the Moment suggests the right dua for the time of day and the Islamic calendar — morning, evening, Ramadan, Hajj and Eid.
HAJJ & UMRAH
A step-by-step guide to performing Umrah and Hajj, with recorded duas, in English and Urdu — plus the duas of the journey.
DAILY REMINDERS
A Quran verse chosen for the time and the date (Al-Kahf on Fridays, the fasting verses in Ramadan), with a dua in the evening. Tap to read.
ALSO INCLUDED (URDU)
Complete Seerat-un-Nabi (PBUH), the lives of 33 Sahabah, fiqh rulings, Islamic history and poetry — a full Urdu library alongside the English one.
MADE FOR YOU
• Dark Mode that follows your iPhone, or stays Light or Dark
• 19 theme colours
• Pinch to resize text in the Quran, hadith and dua readers
• Share a verse as a link that opens straight in IslamOne
• Spot a mistake? Report it from the verse, hadith or dua itself
WHY ISLAMONE
• 100% free — no ads, no subscription, no locked features
• Read offline: the Quran, translations, hadith and duas are all on your device
• Built for bilingual households: read in English, share with family who read Urdu
Download IslamOne and share it with your family and friends. Jazak Allah Khair!

bluejetty:00017180:ios.summary: Hey, what song is that? SoundHound makes it simple to identify music playing around you. Whether you’re in the car or out and about — open the app, hit the big orange SoundHound button, let your phone listen for a few seconds, and we’ll tel
bluejetty:00017180:ios.description:
Hey, what song is that? SoundHound makes it simple to identify music playing around you. Whether you’re in the car or out and about — open the app, hit the big orange SoundHound button, let your phone listen for a few seconds, and we’ll tell you exactly what’s playing! It's been called pure magic — and with 300M+ downloads and billions of songs discovered — we tend to agree.
SoundHound comes equipped with “Hey SoundHound…”, an incredibly powerful way to interact with the app using your voice. “Hey SoundHound…” can help you navigate the app, activate the orange button, and playback songs hands-free. Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound...’ from any screen and say a command!
Discovering new music is only half the fun of SoundHound. We’re music lovers too, so we’ve created an incredible experience for you to relive your discoveries with our music player. Connect your Apple Music or Spotify account to listen, build playlists, explore music across genres, and find new favorites - all with real-time, karaoke-style lyrics using LiveLyrics®. Don’t have an Apple Music or Spotify subscription? No sweat, we have you covered with our free, built-in YouTube player. This is your music journey.
Curious to know more? Here’s everything you need to know!
DISCOVER
• Tap the SoundHound button in the app, in the notification center widget, or via 3D touch on the app icon to discover music playing around you! We’ll let you know everything about the song including title, artist, album, and lyrics!
• Have a song stuck in your head? Press the SoundHound button, sing or hum the tune, and we’ll do the rest!
• Keep track of all your discoveries in your own personal history
• Use the Apple Watch app to quickly identify music and sing-along with LiveLyrics. Users with a cellular-enabled Apple Watch can use the app without being connected to an iPhone
PLAY
• Listen to songs and view lyrics in our free, built-in YouTube player
• Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound....’ from any screen or tap the microphone on the play page. Once you see the listening panel, you can follow up with commands including:
App Navigation: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me my discoveries’
Help/Questions: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me what I can say’
Music Discovery: ‘Hey SoundHound… What’s that song?’
Song Playback: ‘Hey SoundHound... Play Hello by Adele’
Lyrics Search: ‘Hey SoundHound... Show me lyrics to Castle on the Hill’
Top Charts: ‘Hey SoundHound...Play today’s top songs’
Playlists (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Play my Discover weekly playlist on Spotify’
Add to Spotify Playlist (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Add this song to my playlist’
CONNECT AND SHARE
• Build personalized playlists through Apple Music or Spotify (SoundHound account and music subscription required)
• Access Spotify playlists for a richer playback experience through SoundHound
• View and interact with real-time, moving lyrics for your songs with LiveLyrics
• Keep all of your discoveries synced across multiple devices
• Share your music discoveries to Facebook, Twitter, messaging services, and email!
Upgrade to SoundHound∞ for an ad-free experience: https://04ii.app.link/RXaRXypntA
SoundHound is powered by Houndify, an independent voice-enabled AI platform that enables natural, conversational intelligence on any product.

bluejetty:00040737:ios.name: Bible Reading Made Easy
bluejetty:00040737:ios.summary: We have developed Bible Reading Made Easy to supply Christians with high quality resources for spiritual devotion, as well as to spread and bear witness to the gospel of the heavenly kingdom to more and more people. Through this app, you ca
bluejetty:00040737:ios.description:
We have developed Bible Reading Made Easy to supply Christians with high quality resources for spiritual devotion, as well as to spread and bear witness to the gospel of the heavenly kingdom to more and more people. Through this app, you can use a variety of Bible translations to compare readings so that it is more convenient for you to understand the Bible. We have also prepared for you rich spiritual content and testimony articles that are true to life. We hope that these can help you solve the problems and confusions that you have in your spiritual and daily life, establish a normal relationship with God, and obtain more enlightenment from God.
The app functionality is simple and clear enough for anyone to use, so wherever you are, you can start your spiritual journey at the touch of a button in your spare time.
Why Use Bible Reading Made Easy?
• It is completely free and you can enjoy all the features at no cost. This app allows you to read the Scriptures hassle-free.
• Handpicked Bible passages come with interpretations to give you a relaxing reading experience.
• Bible Study provides you with high-quality articles explaining Bible passages, as well as Bible study topics of concern for Christians, to guide you into more profound study of the Bible.
• The app includes articles explaining biblical prophecies to help you study the fulfillment and accomplishment of God’s prophecies about the last days, so that their true meaning is made clear.
• With a handpicked selection of testimony articles, we share with you real experiences of Christians who have relied on God and seen God’s deeds when they were faced with difficulty and tribulation in their lives to allow you to sense God’s love and salvation.
• Here you can find hymn videos, gospel films, and all sorts of videos on Christians’ lives of faith, giving you a greater understanding of God’s work and opening more truths and mysteries to you.
• All sorts of beautiful images are available for you to download and share free!
Features
• Custom images: A simple, easy way to create your own images, adding your favorite Bible verses.
• Q&A: Whether it’s a question that comes up while reading Scripture or a difficulty you encounter in everyday life, you can ask us anything. You can also search for key terms to find the answers you’re seeking.
• Scripture navigation: Provides convenient and flexible methods for navigating the Scriptures to help you more quickly locate the passages of the Bible you need to begin your journey of reading the Scriptures.
• Multi-text comparison: Allows simultaneous comparison of multiple translations of the Bible, making reference and comparison of Scripture convenient.

bluejetty:00016039:ios.description:
Belote & Coinche: le Défi - Install the new Belote game now!
Welcome to the new universe of Belote and Coinche, Belote & Coinche: le Défi!
This free game is dedicated to all enthusiasts who want to recreate the atmosphere of live games.
Dive into an adventure full of challenges, prizes, and pure excitement.
Key Features:
● Play for free and online: Download the game for free and join thousands of online players.
● Daily bonuses and free chests: Special prizes await you every day. The more you play, the more you win.
● Special events and tournaments: Celebrate unique moments with thematic events and compete in exciting tournaments.
● Mini-games: Between games, enjoy slot machines and scratch cards to earn extra prizes.
● Variety of tables: Choose your table based on the level and stakes you want to bet.
● Advanced Coinche: Try the Tout Atout and Sans Atout options for even more fun.
Exclusive news:
● Weekly Championship: Every Tuesday, the championship of your rank begins, where you can earn points by winning games or completing recipes. Climbing ranks brings you increasingly rich rewards. Only the best will scale the heights of the championship!
● Join Clubs: Win games to open your club's chest. Exchange ingredients with other members, improve your club's league and get bigger prizes.
● Monthly Pass: Play Belote or Coinche and unlock a chest every day! Chests also allow you to earn stars to play at the exclusive premium table! Activate Gold and Ultra passes to get even richer rewards like the booster for the horse race!
● Premium Pass Table: Participate in the new premium table and win extraordinary prizes for your club. Use the stars earned by completing the stages of the Monthly Pass.
● Horse Race: Help your club's stable reach the top to get an exclusive badge. But be careful not to be demoted!
● The Gourmet Palace: By winning Belote and Coinche games, collect ingredients to prepare delicious recipes. Each dish prepared brings you special prizes. Unlock all the restaurants and win more and more prizes!
● Safe: Every time you play a game, deposit coins and tokens in the safe for free. You can decide to open the safe at a special price by the end of the month before it resets.
The higher your rank, the bigger your safe!
Don't know the rules of the game? No problem, learn how to play with a practical and fast tutorial, available at any time.
A welcome gift awaits you!
Open the game for the first time and receive a super welcome gift!
Start your journey in Belote & Coinche: le Défi on the right foot!
What are you waiting for?
Download Belote & Coinche: le Défi now and join a community of card game enthusiasts.
Your first gift awaits you in the game, ready to start this exciting adventure!
Do you have questions or comments?
Contact us through the in-game support or write to us at help@whatwapp.com.
Also, follow us on our Facebook page: BeloteLeDefi.

bluejetty:00045354:ios.summary:
SENDY is an online marketplace and Gear Hub that lets community members Buy, Sell and Rent Adventure Sports equipment anywhere in North America.
BUY IT.

SELL
bluejetty:00045354:ios.description:
SENDY is an online marketplace and Gear Hub that lets community members Buy, Sell and Rent Adventure Sports equipment anywhere in North America.
BUY IT.
SENDY makes it safe and easy to find used equipment beyond just your local area.
SELL IT.
No more gear sitting around in garages and closets. SENDY makes it safe and easy to turn gear into cash.
RENT IT.
Find and rent gear from stores and individuals anywhere and anytime with the click of a button.
SENDY is designed to get more people outside, get more people connecting with each other, the natural world, and their own true nature.
SENDY is about a community. A community that helps each other get outside, get in their bodies, and feel the way nature always meant for them to feel.
We don’t just want a happy planet, we want happy people too, and SENDY is the tool we can use to solve both problems. What do you have that someone else might need? Every single piece of gear that finds a new home is one less new product getting pumped out of a factory and shipped around the world. Every single piece of gear that finds a new home helps someone chase their dreams, drop into their bodies and focus on what matters.
The problem is not that we don’t have enough things, it’s that those things are inefficiently distributed. We have the power to change this forever. And by We, I mean You. Every single individual reading these words. If every one of us makes sure that we let nothing go to waste, nothing sit around collecting dust and getting outdated then the problem is solved. Imagine a world in which everyone who wants to thrive in nature has what they need to do so. Imagine the generations of lives that can change if we give families the tools to return to the great outdoors.

bluejetty:00062407:ios.description:
Lifey: Video Forums for Real-Life Advice
Lifey is a video forum app where real people answer real questions — on camera. Browse over 1,400 video forums on college, careers, health, money, dating, parenting and more, with 35,000+ honest answers from people who've actually been there.
What makes a video forum different
A text forum gives you opinions from strangers. A Lifey video forum gives you faces, voices and real experience. Every answer is a short video from someone who lived it — so you can read tone, sincerity and context that text can never carry.
Find the forum for your question
Thousands of video forums, organised by the things people actually search for:
• Colleges, majors, high school and homeschool
• Careers, job hunting, leadership and retirement
• Health conditions, mental health, fitness and weight loss
• Personal finance, budgeting, frugal living and scams
• Dating, marriage, parenting, pregnancy and divorce
• Countries, US cities, travel, and moving
• Faith, service missions and life stories
Anyone can add a video answer. Pick a forum, record a short video, and help the next person facing what you already figured out. It takes a couple of minutes and it stays there for whoever needs it.
Safe, moderated, family-friendly
Every video is reviewed before it appears. No explicit content, no profanity, no cyber bullying— just people helping people.
Why people use Lifey
• 1,400+ video forums across education, careers, health, money and relationships
• 35,000+ video answers from real people
• Moderated and family-friendly — safe to hand to a teenager
• Free to browse, free to contribute
"If you feel you have wisdom to share with someone out there, this is a wholesome place to do that." — Emily G.
"As a Dad of teens this is gold to me — an app with content I can trust through and through." — Jason H.
Download Lifey and find the video forum for whatever you're facing.

bluejetty:00035443:ios.description:
The GoZone app makes it easier than ever to move around Denton County, TX! With a few taps in the app, book a ride and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the affordability and efficiency of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparable to public transportation, and you can add people to your bookings for even less. GoZone offers one of the most affordable rideshare options in the nation!
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
How does GoZone work?
GoZone is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the app, input your location and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before!
How long will I wait?
- You’ll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking.
- You can also track your vehicle in real-time using the app.
Questions? Reach out at gozone@dcta.net.
Loving your experience so far? Give us 5-star rating with your feedback!

bluejetty:00027951:ios.description:
Welcome to Hotel Rush: Merge Story, the ultimate merge game where your inner business tycoon meets heartwarming adventure! In this tycoon game, you’ll step into the world of hospitality—take over a charming inn or mansion, rebuild, renovatae, and restore it to glory. Whether you’re a fan of decor games, design games, or puzzle games, this free hotel game delivers a perfect blend of home design games, merge adventure, and idle hotel gameplay.
Begin Your Hotel Journey – Hotel Rush: Merge Story
You inherit a dusty old hotel, inn, or manor full of hidden treasures and family secrets. With your merge skills, you combine everyday objects—can merging an heirloom and a broken lamp unlock a hidden estate secret?
How to Play – Merge, Decorate & Manage
• Merge game mania: match and merge objects—broken tools, heirlooms, décor pieces—to create upgraded items and unlock new floors. Enjoy the merging games flow, whether online or merge games offline.
• Decorating as you go: use your new tools to design the lobby, rooms, and gardens. From interior design touches to sweeping mansion makeover scenes, your creativity shines in home décor, house design, and family home games style.
• Adventure meets business: act like a hotel manager or business tycoon—hire staff, manage services, clean rooms, upgrade facilities, and expand your venture.
Why You’ll Love This Free Hotel Game
Easy merge mechanics make this 3d merge and merge story experience accessible and addictive.
Design freedom: unleash your sense of style through designing games elements—decorate each room just how you envision.
Casual yet deep: perfect as a family game, whether you're tackling quick merges or immersing in full merge adventure sessions.
No Wi-Fi needed: enjoy it as a no wifi game, merging and designing on the go, offline.
Key Features
— Dynamic gameplay: turn everyday items into powerful tools with every merge game step.
— Engage in decor games fun by designing hotel interiors, exterior façades, and grand manor spaces.
— Blend adventure and storytelling as you help Ted uncover hidden family heirlooms and legacy.
— Manage your hotel empire with hotel manager mechanics—staff, upgrades, and customer satisfaction.
Solve engaging puzzles to restore rooms, renovate the estate, and solve puzzles that reveal new secrets.
Join the world of Hotel Rush: Merge Story
Whether you're a fan of merge games, design games, house games, or tycoon games, this merge design masterpiece combines all your favorite themes into one relaxing yet deeply rewarding home design games experience. So start your merge adventure, become a savvy business tycoon, and show off your design and merge skills. Welcome to your dream hotel game, where happy merge home stories come alive.

Easy merge mechanics make this 3d merge and merge story experience accessible and addictive.

Design freedom: unleash your sense of style through designing games elements—decorate each room just how you envision.

Casual yet deep: perfect as a family game, whether you're tackling quick merges or immersing in full merge adventure sessions.

No Wi-Fi needed: enjoy it as a no wifi game, merging and designing on the go, offline.

— Dynamic gameplay: turn everyday items into powerful tools with every merge game step.
— Engage in decor games fun by designing hotel interiors, exterior façades, and grand manor spaces.
— Blend adventure and storytelling as you help Ted uncover hidden family heirlooms and legacy.
— Manage your hotel empire with hotel manager mechanics—staff, upgrades, and customer satisfaction.

Solve engaging puzzles to restore rooms, renovate the estate, and solve puzzles that reveal new secrets.

Join the world of Hotel Rush: Merge Story
Whether you're a fan of merge games, design games, house games, or tycoon games, this merge design masterpiece combines all your favorite themes into one relaxing yet deeply rewarding home design games experience. So start your merge adventure, become a savvy business tycoon, and show off your design and merge skills. Welcome to your dream hotel game, where happy merge home stories come alive.

bluejetty:00042537:ios.description:
It’s time to transform your life and live without fear of your future. The Women’s Real Estate Investors Network is a community of like-minded women who want the opportunity to create financial freedom through investing in real estate.
WREIN is empowering women from all walks of life to achieve financial freedom, while inspiring and transforming generations.
It unlocks potential, fuels ambition, and creates limitless possibilities for families everywhere.
At the WREIN, we aspire to empower women—providing comprehensive holistic real estate, business and legacy education that inspires financial freedom and peace of mind.
We recognize that we are part of something much bigger than ourselves. When a woman joins our network, the impact goes far beyond the individual.
The transformation she experiences creates a ripple effect that extends to her family, friends, and community, inspiring positive change and growth.
Together, we are not only empowering women but also shaping the world we want to live in - a world of equality, opportunity, and collective progress.
Our mission is to break the barriers that have historically limited women's participation in the real estate investing industry.
We are committed to showing everyday women that becoming a real estate investor is not only possible but achievable for them too.
We have seen firsthand that women can do hard things. After all, they raise children, manage households, and excel in various careers.
Women have proven time and again that they possess the strength, resilience, and determination needed to overcome challenges and achieve great feats.
At WREIN, we believe it's time to level the playing field by contributing to a more equitable and inclusive industry.
Together, we’ll navigate the world of Real Estate through: 
+ Group Coaching with experienced expert coaches
+ Mentoring with the Founder of WREIN
+ Design A Life You Love and starting living as the woman you desire to be
+ Accountability to stay committed to achieving your personal version of success
+ Access to specialized knowledge of Women’s REI Results
+ Exclusive Member only events
+ Learn How to Live A Legacy Now and Leave A Legacy for future generations
+ Be Celebrated for every milestone along your investing journey
+ Receive encouragement by fellow WREIN Sisters
+ Connect with women seeking financial freedom like you
+ Partner with women on real estate deals
+ Transform your family’s future and secure your finances
In the WREIN app, members can access networking opportunities, exclusive events, and life changing content to create financial freedom and build a legacy.

The image
bluejetty:00016863:ios.description:
Have you ever wanted to take a photo in low light conditions?
Due to complex mathematical algorithms Night Eyes provides residual light amplification in real-time for your iPhone, iPad and iPod touch without additional hardware.
The image is illuminated in real-time (without delay). You can also switch the light amplification mode to exposure mode for better quality. With an exposure time of up to one second you will be able to view the smallest details. It's ideal for twilight situations.
The luminance histogram shows you the brightness level in real-time.
Zoom in inconspicuously using the 10x digital Live Zoom - and shoot your photos.
You've naturally got many different color filters to choose from.
The most important functions are:
- Three amplification modes
- Up to 1 second * exposure time
- Residual light amplification
- True low light enhancement
- Real-time luminance histogram
- Volume Up (+) Photo Capture
- 10x digital live zoom
- Tap to focus
- Color filters: green, red, blue, b/w, sepia, etc.
- Take HD photos
- Landscape and portrait modes
- Supports the front & back cameras
- Supports LED lights
- Supports EXIF-data
*) only on supported devices
A good camera and a powerful processor are required, to get the maximum picture quality.
All the screenshots listed were taken with an iPhone and iPad and are genuine!
Please note that this app does not provide true night vision functionality. The iPhone, iPad and iPod touch have no infrared amplifier, as a result no pictures can be taken in total darkness; a minimal level of light is still required, which can be ascertained by the camera's sensors. The preview will also be delayed in exposure mode. In addition the camera must be held stable for exposure time.

KEY FEATURES
Calendar
• Stay focused on daily basis
• Create custom blocks/events to study, work or enjoying a family dinner
• Custom block lists for specific apps or categories
App Restrictions: 
• Instantly block distracting apps and websites with the #1 blocker. 
• Control your screen time and stop doomscrolling.
Focus Sessions: 
• Block apps and websites while you're working to maintain deep focus. 
• You can always take a break to unblock them temporarily.
BENEFITS 
Better Screen Time Management: Save at least one hour daily by reducing distractions.
Increased Productivity: 93% of users report being more productive thanks to the app.
Improved Mental Health: 90% of users experience reduced stress and improved mindfulness.
Enhanced Focus: 94% of users report feeling less distracted and more focused.
CREATE A PERSONALIZED APP LIST
You can add or remove any App and Website that are distracting to you directly from To Do Lock's settings in the app.
You can customize your To do Lock experience and block all apps and sites on your phone, including:
- Facebook
- Instagram
- Snapchat
- TikTok
- Youtube
- Netflix
- Tinder
- Hinge
- Bumble
- Many more: News, Messaging, Dating, Adult/Porn, Money apps etc.
PRIVATE & SAFE
We use Apple's Screen Time API in order to monitor and block apps you use. Installation is easy and takes a few seconds on your iPhone.
Unlike most apps, App Blocker works entirely on your phone and personal browsing data never leaves your device.
Subscription pricing and terms:
App Blocker offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $99.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the all features while you maintain an active subscription.

bluejetty:00060776:ios.summary:
Yomu is an independent reader for book lovers. Yomu’s design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability and distraction-free reading.
Designed to let you focus on reading, Yomu has no unnecessary prefer
bluejetty:00060776:ios.description:
Yomu is an independent reader for book lovers. Yomu’s design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability and distraction-free reading.
Designed to let you focus on reading, Yomu has no unnecessary preferences. Just open a book and start reading. Yomu’s fluid layout dynamically adjusts all text properties and margins depending on your preferred styles and device, giving you an optimal reading experience.
FORMATS
Yomu supports standard ebooks without digital rights management.
Supported formats:
- EPub (.epub)
- Mobi (.mobi, .prc)
- Kindle (.azw, .azw3, .kf8)
- Comics (.cbz, .cbr)
- PDF (.pdf) 
Choose free books from publishers such as Standard Ebooks or Project Gutenberg. Download ebooks directly from your browser or copy files from other apps. Import files with iCloud Drive, iTunes File Sharing, or from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, OPDS and Calibre.
READER
The reader's design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability.
Choose your favorite theme font (Lato, Georgia, Lexend, OpenDyslexic, ...), reader mode (day, sepia, grey, black, ...), select a preset or custom font size, content layout (page, scroll) and many more options. All settings can be saved as your personal default for each book.
Swipe or tap to go to the next page. You can also use the book's content outline or table of contents to navigate to another chapter.
While reading EPub, Mobi and Kindle books, select text to take notes or highlight favorite sections. Create bookmarks or search inside ebooks to quickly find anything you are looking for.
LIBRARY
Organise your books in an easy to use library.
Manage your library by creating folders or tags to organize your books. Sort your collection either by title, author, series, recently read or drag and drop for a custom order.
You can edit a document's title, author, summary, cover or any other meta data. Save or export your books with all information and annotations in text, markdown or json format.
CLOUD
Yomu's Cloud Library (pro only) stores your books and annotations securely in Apple's iCloud.
Keep all your ebooks safe and at hand on whatever device. Every time you change something on one device, it's synced to all your other devices. Always have the latest version, when you start reading on your iPad and continue on your iPhone on the go.
Please note that you need to be signed in on your device with the same Apple ID on all platforms.
WIDGETS
See your recently read books or highlighted quotes.
Yomu includes widgets to quickly view and open your books and quotes. Add a widget from the gallery and choose a list from the options. Tap on an entry to continue reading where you left off.
YOMU PRO
Yomu is free to use and includes all basic features.
Every ebook format, theme or setting is available and lets you try out the unrestricted reader. However, the free version has some limitations and does not include certain features.
Upgrade to Yomu Pro to get:
- Cloud Library: Store and sync your library with Apple’s iCloud.
- Unlimited Documents: No limit on the number of documents.
- No Advertisement: Free version can display ads.
Yomu is an independent app, your purchase supports the further development.
When you buy an in-app purchase, you are doing so through Apple’s App Store and agree to their terms and conditions. Payments will be charged to the credit card of your Apple account.
SERVICE
Yomu is available for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
In contrast to other apps, Yomu does not collect or sell any personal information. And it keeps your data private.
Terms of Service:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/terms/
Privacy Policy:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/privacy/
Support:
https://www.yomu-reader.com/support/

bluejetty:00018663:ios.description:
Feed those in need, one picture at a time.
Over 40 million Americans currently face hunger, not knowing where they will find their next meal. GiftAMeal allows you to help at no cost.
Simply take a photo on the GiftAMeal app at a participating restaurant to provide a meal to someone in need in your community. Share your picture on social media to give additional meals! Your photo can be of food, drink, a receipt, friends, something cool at the restaurant, or even a selfie.
How does it work? Restaurants pay to be on our app as a mix of marketing and giving back - it’s free for you! Anytime you take a photo at one of our participating restaurants, GiftAMeal makes a donation to a local food bank. These donations go towards distributing nutritious food to neighborhood pantries where those in need can access it.
Over 1 million meals have been gifted to those in need so far. And every meal makes a difference. Bridgett, a single mom who previously relied on a local pantry for support, shared her story with us: “My daughter is 15. The food program really, really helped us. Her grades have gone sky-high. We’re in a good place now - we have a house and food and now we’re going to give back.”
Help someone like Bridgett with GiftAMeal today!
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: @GiftAMeal
Instagram: @GiftAMeal
Twitter: @GiftAMeal
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Learn more at: www.giftameal.com

bluejetty:00070370:ios.description:
APLICATIVO DE GESTÃO, COMUNICAÇÃO E SEGURANÇA DE CONDOMÍNIOS.
Nosso objetivo é facilitar a vida de síndicos, porteiros e moradores de condomínios. 
Chega de papel! Tudo que você precisa em um só lugar. Reservas, ocorrências, visitantes, cadastro de moradores, informativos, enquetes, documentos e muito mais.
Tudo isso a dois cliques do seu smartphone. 
Através de um sistema 100% online, é possível enviar aviso aos moradores, marcar assembleias, reservar espaços em comum, realizar enquetes, controlar os acessos na portaria e muito mais.
VEJA TUDO QUE PODE CONTROLAR DO SEU CELULAR
LIVRO DE OCORRÊNCIAS
Seu livro de ocorrência digital e portátil! Registre reclamações, sugestões, acompanhe o tratamento e seja notificado quando a ocorrência for resolvida. 
ENTREGAS E ENCOMENDAS
Gestão completa das entradas e saídas de todas as correspondências. Seja notificado quando a sua encomenda chegar.
AUTORIZAÇÃO DE VISITANTES
Envie um QRCODE para seu convidado. Seja notificado quando eles chegarem. 
CONTROLE FINANCEIRO
Emita boletos, controle a inadimplência, automatize suas cobranças, pagamentos, controle a folha de pagamentos, e-social, emita seus balancetes. 
MANUTENÇÃO
Controle das manutenções periódicas. A administração será avisada que uma manutenção esta próxima.
PRODUTOS E SERVIÇOS
Conheça e avalie serviços fornecidos por outros moradores.
INFORMATIVOS
Baixe o regimento interno e atas. Seja notificado quando um novo aviso for postado pela administração.
VOTAÇÃO DIGITAL
Vote temas importantes sem aglomerações.
INSCRIÇÕES EM ATIVIDADES
Se inscreva nas atividades oferecidas pelo condomínio. Seja notificado quando surgirem novas vagas.
RESERVAS
Consulte a disponibilidade e reserve/cancele sua área de lazer.
PREGÃO ELETRÔNICO
Cadastre fornecedores e faça seus pedidos de compra. Receba os orçamentos e selecione a melhor proposta.
VOTAÇÃO ONLINE
Faça uma pesquisa rápida e liste as assinaturas digitais dos moradores.
FORNEÇA UMA NOVA EXPERIÊNCIA AOS SEUS CONDÔMINOS 
O morador poderá abrir ocorrências, reservar áreas, autorizar a entrada de visitantes, receber informativos e muito mais, tudo pelo celular.
Ocorrências aberta por um morador é visualizada somente pelo próprio morador e pelo administrador. Outros moradores não acessam as ocorrências abertas.
 Todo tratamento feito na sua ocorrência dispara uma notificação para o seu celular. Quando a ocorrência eh finalizada, você recebera instruções de aprovar ou reprovar a solução dada.
Pode ser feito o cadastro de informações importantes como falta de água ou mudança de procedimentos internos.
Podem também ser disponibilizado documentos como regimento interno, convenção coletiva e atas de reunião. Todos os usuários receberão notificações avisando do novo informativo. O aplicativo informa ao administrador os moradores que já leram ou não o informativo.
TUDO O QUE ACONTECE NO SEU CONDOMÍNIO A DOIS CLIQUES DO SEU SMARTPHONE FÁCIL E RÁPIDO DE IMPLANTAR!
Pague por unidade. Adequado para todos os tamanhos de condomínio.
É o mundo digital proporcionando mais facilidade, conforto, transparência e economia.

bluejetty:00019530:ios.summary:
Great to see you, Commander!
War Robots is the biggest shooter game about giant robots that fits into your pocket. Join epic PvP battles against rivals from all over the world and show them who’s the smartest, fastest, toughest pilot around
bluejetty:00019530:ios.description:
Great to see you, Commander!
War Robots is the biggest shooter game about giant robots that fits into your pocket. Join epic PvP battles against rivals from all over the world and show them who’s the smartest, fastest, toughest pilot around! Prepare for surprise attacks, intricate tactical maneuvers and other tricks up enemies’ sleeves. Destroy! Capture! Upgrade! Become stronger — and prove yourself as the best mech commander in the War Robots online universe!
MAIN FEATURES
- Choose your fighter. Over 50 robots with unique designs and powers let you find a style to call your own.
- Play how you want. Want to crush and destroy? To save and protect? Or just annoy the hell out of your enemies? You can do it all with the massive selection of weapons, including ballistic missiles, plasma cannons, and giant shotguns!
- Customize. Each robot can be fitted with weapons and modules of your choice. Find your favorite combo and show everyone what you’ve got!
- Battle together in multiplayer. Team up with other people! Join a powerful clan to find trusty partners (and friends!), or even start your own!
- Battle on your own. Prefer playing solo? Lone wolves can express themselves in special modes like Arena or Free-for-All!
- Explore the lore. The War Robots world grows and expands with every update, and the ever-growing community is always ready to help you.
Looking for more action?
Check out the latest news on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/warrobots/
…or Twitter: https://twitter.com/WWR_by_Pixonic
Watch War Robots TV on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/WALKINGWARROBOTS
Hop on Reddit for in-depth discussions: https://www.reddit.com/r/walkingwarrobots/
And visit our official website for articles, patch notes and development stories: https://warrobots.com
Note: War Robots requires a stable internet connection for the best gameplay experience.
Good hunting, Commander!
PLEASE NOTE! War Robots is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. In-App purchases may include random items. The application contains ads.

bluejetty:00017776:ios.description:
CSB iBank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CSB iBank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Turn your debit card off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CSB iBank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a CSB iBank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

MealKeyway: Enjoy the convenience of app ordering with your favorite restaurant in mind. This is a customized online ordering app launched by MenuSifu, dedicated to providing diners with a convenient ordering experience and exclusive discounts.
FEATURES: Effortlessly discover the menu, place orders, and review your order history and receipts. Receive timely notifications to keep up with your favorite restaurants' latest trends and promotions from your favorite restaurants. Choose between delivery and pickup for the service that suits you best.
HOW IT WORKS: To get started, simply scan the MealKeyway app QR code provided by the restaurant. You'll typically find this QR code on restaurant posters, menus, flyers, or banners. It may also be available on the restaurant's website or social media profiles.
NOTES: MealKeyway is not your typical food-ordering marketplace app. We prioritize specific restaurants that have chosen to participate in our rewards program. For the app to work correctly, it is imperative that restaurants partner with MealKeyway. Additionally, users must link their app to the unique QR code provided by the restaurant to ensure proper functionality.
If you have any questions, please contact our customer support team at 212-898-0888 or assist@menusifu.com

apple-itunes:6819981217.name: LL Pair: Developer Mode
apple-itunes:6819981217.description:
Designed for LocationLab users, LL Pair helps you prepare Developer Mode and pair locally on an iPhone running iOS 27 or later. Export the resulting pairing file for use with LocationLab or other tools that support this format. LL Pair itself does not require those apps to be installed.
If Developer Mode is missing from Settings, use the Show It option in LL Pair, then enable it in system Settings, restart, and confirm as iOS instructs. LL Pair cannot turn on the system switch for you.
Once enabled, select the LL Pair pairing host in Settings and enter the code shown by the app. After pairing succeeds, send the file directly to a compatible version of LocationLab or export it to a destination you choose.
Pairing credentials remain on this iPhone unless you explicitly send or export them. Keep the file secure. LL Pair does not provide location or VPN features and does not download a Developer Disk Image.

- Simple shapes, colors and sizes
- Animals and birds
- Land, water, and space transport
- much more
The application allows your child to develop logic, as well as attention, fine motor skills and discipline successfully and independently.
